t: An open FPGA board with fast memory and add-on modules for video and signals.
steps: Buy the iCE40HX8K-EVB from the Olimex store for about 30 euros.
Get a 5 V power supply with a barrel plug.
Get an SPI programmer, such as an Olimexino-32U4, a Raspberry Pi, or an FT2232H adapter.
Install Project IceStorm, Yosys, nextpnr, and iceprog on your computer.
Download the Olimex iCE40HX8K-EVB repo with its demos.
Build the blinking LED demo and upload it through the 10-pin PGM connector.
Add the VGA module and try the video demo next.
